assessment_objectives.objective: architecture requirements define the technology stack as modular and interoperable, with documented integration points between components.

Technology Assets, Applications and Services (TAAS) in the technology stack expose or consume documented, standards-based interfaces (e.g., open Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) or industry-standard protocols) that enable components to be integrated or replaced without redesign of the stack.
commercial Technology Assets, Applications and Services (TAAS) are evaluated for interoperability with the existing technology stack before acquisition or integration.
the technology stack architecture is maintained, including documentation of components, integration points and dependencies, and is updated when components are added, replaced or retired.
